plan.title: Household Survey Dashboard
plan.subtitle: Overview of survey coverage by village, enumerator, and submission trends

panels.title: Total households surveyed
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM "household_survey" WHERE "start" IS NOT NULL AND "end" IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Households by village
panels.sql: SELECT "village", COUNT(*) AS n FROM "household_survey" WHERE "start" IS NOT NULL AND "end" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Households by enumerator
panels.sql: SELECT "enumerator_name", COUNT(*) AS n FROM "household_survey" WHERE "start" IS NOT NULL AND "end" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Monthly submissions trend
panels.sql: WITH monthly_submissions AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', TO_TIMESTAMP("_submission_time", 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MI:SS')) AS month, COUNT(*) AS total FROM "household_survey" WHERE "start" IS NOT NULL AND "end" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) SELECT month, total FROM monthly_submissions

panels.title: Top 10 villages by number of households
panels.sql: SELECT "village", COUNT(*) AS n FROM "household_survey" WHERE "start" IS NOT NULL AND "end" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This dashboard provides an overview of the household survey coverage. {{p1}} households were surveyed across different villages and enumerators. The distribution of households by village is shown in {{p2}}, highlighting the most represented areas. Similarly, {{p3}} displays the distribution by enumerator, showing which enumerators have surveyed the most households. The monthly trend of submissions is visualized in {{p4}}, indicating the volume of data collected over time. For a detailed view of the top 10 villages by number of households, refer to {{p5}}.
